# Plus curated plugin repository — template

Copy this directory's contents into the curated repository
(`SakuraLoveSmile/Pi-Desktop-Plus-Plugins`), commit, and push. Nothing here is
generated by the app; it is the publishing side of the Plus channel.

```
catalog.json                     generated by scripts/generate-catalog.mjs
packages/<pluginId>-<version>.piplug
approved/<pluginId>/<version>.json
scripts/generate-catalog.mjs
```

## Adding a reviewed version

1. Build the `.piplug` package and place it at
   `packages/<pluginId>-<version>.piplug`.
2. Compute its SHA-256 and byte size.
3. Write `approved/<pluginId>/<version>.json` copying `name`, `description`,
   `author`, `permissions` and `minPiDesktop` from the package manifest, and
   recording the upstream `sourceRepository`, `sourceCommit` and `license`.
4. Run `node scripts/generate-catalog.mjs`.
5. Commit the package, the approval record and the regenerated `catalog.json`
   in one commit. Relative package URLs resolve against this repository, so a
   download can never be sent to another provider.

A version is only installable when a maintainer approved exactly those bytes.
Changed bytes or a new version require a new approval record.

## Withdrawing a version

Replace the record's `decision` with `"yanked"`, add a `reason`, and regenerate
the catalog. The version stays in history so an installed copy can show why it
was withdrawn; it is excluded from install and update paths.

## Rules

- Never publish a version without an approval record: `catalog.json` is
  generated from `approved/`, which is the allowlist.
- Never copy an upstream catalog wholesale — that would label unreviewed
  versions as reviewed.
- Keep upstream authorship and license; the Plus label describes the review,
  not who wrote the plugin, and is not a safety guarantee.
- Keep the repository public: the client reads the catalog unauthenticated.
- Do not hand-edit `catalog.json`; regenerate it.
